rules.statement: A statement of relevant facts cannot be admitted under section 32 unless it consists of the very words of the deceased person and comes within one of the cases (1) to (8) in that section.
rules.supporting_quote: "Now D1 cannot be admitted in evidence for the reason that it does not contain a statement made by the deceased. Apart from that, the statements in the letter do not fall within anyone of the eight cases in section 32."
